name: 33473 · Boynton Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33473 (Boynton Beach) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33473 (Boynton Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
